title: Real Madrid fear Arda Guler injury to end season, optimistic for World Cup and USA clash
content:
Real Madrid fear Arda Guler will miss the remainder of the season after sustaining a hamstring injury in his right leg.

Sources close to the player with knowledge of the situation are optimistic, however, that the midfielder will be able to go to the World Cup with Turkey.

Guler, 21, is arguably the most accomplished individual player in the tournament’s Group D, where Turkey will meet the United States in the potentially pivotal final group game.

He started Real Madrid’s La Liga win against Alaves on Tuesday but was replaced by Franco Mastantuono in the 58th minute. The Spanish side confirmed on Thursday he had been “diagnosed with a muscle injury in the biceps femoris of his right leg” after tests that day, which is expected to keep him out for the remainder of the season.

Madrid are second in La Liga, nine points behind Barcelona with six games to go, and face the league leaders in the Clasico on May 10.

They are set to also be without Eder Militao, 28, who the club confirmed has sustained the same injury as the Turkey international, but to his left leg, and fear he could face a similar spell on the sidelines. Sources close to the situation have confirmed that Brazil still expect the defender at the World Cup.

Guler has made 50 appearances in all competitions for Madrid in this campaign, scoring six goals and providing 14 assists. He has also played in all but one of his national team’s World Cup qualification fixtures.

After a 1-0 win over Kosovo in the World Cup play-offs, Turkey secured a place in the tournament. Their first match will be against Australia on June 13 in 51 days time and take on Paraguay on June 19, before the USMNT matchup on June 25.
